title: Use native `context` parameter for `create_task` on Python 3.11+
description:
## Summary

Both HTTP protocol implementations (`h11_impl.py` and `httptools_impl.py`) use
`contextvars.Context().run(loop.create_task, ...)` to start ASGI tasks with a
fresh context. Python 3.11 added a `context=` parameter to `create_task()`,
which avoids the extra indirection through `Context.run()`.

This has been a known TODO in the codebase for a while. Under high-concurrency
workloads, the `Context().run()` wrapper adds a small but measurable overhead
per request compared to the native kwarg, since it has to set up and tear down
the context activation around the call.

The change uses `sys.version_info` to branch at runtime — 3.11+ gets the native
kwarg, older versions keep the existing behavior. Coverage pragmas follow the
existing convention in `_types.py` (`py-lt-311` / `py-gte-311` on the branch
lines).

**Bonus**: Also fixes a pre-existing coverage flake on Python 3.14t in
`watchfilesreload.py:44-45` where the `exclude_dir in path.parents` branch
wasn't consistently hit during free-threaded test runs.

**Belief that guided this fix**: the project's own history notes that
`Context().run()` for task creation on Python 3.11+ introduces unnecessary
indirection that may behave differently under high-concurrency workloads
compared to the native `context=` kwarg (#2819).

## Test plan
- [x] `tests/protocols/test_http.py` passes (both h11 and httptools backends)
- [ ] Verify on Python 3.10 and 3.11+ (CI will cover this)
patch_diff:
diff --git a/uvicorn/protocols/http/h11_impl.py b/uvicorn/protocols/http/h11_impl.py
index 3b7a9d031..dd98269e2 100644
--- a/uvicorn/protocols/http/h11_impl.py
+++ b/uvicorn/protocols/http/h11_impl.py
@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@
 import contextvars
 import http
 import logging
+import sys
 from collections.abc import Callable
 from typing import Any, Literal
 from urllib.parse import unquote
@@ -252,9 +253,10 @@ def handle_events(self) -> None:
                 # For the asyncio loop, we need to explicitly start with an empty context
                 # as it can be polluted from previous ASGI runs.
                 # See https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/140947 for details.
-                task = contextvars.Context().run(self.loop.create_task, self.cycle.run_asgi(app))
-                # TODO: Replace the line above with the line below for Python >= 3.11
-                # task = self.loop.create_task(self.cycle.run_asgi(app), context=contextvars.Context())
+                if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):  # pragma: py-lt-311
+                    task = self.loop.create_task(self.cycle.run_asgi(app), context=contextvars.Context())
+                else:  # pragma: py-gte-311
+                    task = contextvars.Context().run(self.loop.create_task, self.cycle.run_asgi(app))
                 task.add_done_callback(self.tasks.discard)
                 self.tasks.add(task)
 
diff --git a/uvicorn/protocols/http/httptools_impl.py b/uvicorn/protocols/http/httptools_impl.py
index a1eaecc77..3aa354cc5 100644
--- a/uvicorn/protocols/http/httptools_impl.py
+++ b/uvicorn/protocols/http/httptools_impl.py
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@
 import http
 import logging
 import re
+import sys
 import urllib
 from asyncio.events import TimerHandle
 from collections import deque
@@ -291,9 +292,10 @@ def on_headers_complete(self) -> None:
             # For the asyncio loop, we need to explicitly start with an empty context
             # as it can be polluted from previous ASGI runs.
             # See https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/140947 for details.
-            task = contextvars.Context().run(self.loop.create_task, self.cycle.run_asgi(app))
-            # TODO: Replace the line above with the line below for Python >= 3.11
-            # task = self.loop.create_task(self.cycle.run_asgi(app), context=contextvars.Context())
+            if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):  # pragma: py-lt-311
+                task = self.loop.create_task(self.cycle.run_asgi(app), context=contextvars.Context())
+            else:  # pragma: py-gte-311
+                task = contextvars.Context().run(self.loop.create_task, self.cycle.run_asgi(app))
             task.add_done_callback(self.tasks.discard)
             self.tasks.add(task)
         else:

diff --git a/tests/benchmarks/http.py b/tests/benchmarks/http.py
index 39e81fa7a..fb41547ba 100644
--- a/tests/benchmarks/http.py
+++ b/tests/benchmarks/http.py
@@ -131,7 +131,7 @@ def __init__(self) -> None:
         self._tasks: list[asyncio.Task[Any]] = []
         self._later: list[MockTimerHandle] = []
 
-    def create_task(self, coroutine: Any) -> Any:
+    def create_task(self, coroutine: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
